scenes.text: Welcome to Rein Room — a platform where you can train AI agents directly in your browser.
The Guide tab is a great place to start. It introduces the platform and walks you through the learning path.
The Games tab is where you choose an environment for your agent to train in.
Each tab opens a different part of the platform — guide, games, training, and analysis.
At the top, you can load a game, pause training, or speed things up.
On the left, you can watch the agent in real time as it explores the environment.
Here you choose the learning algorithm — Q-Table or DQN — and the exploration strategy.
These sliders let you tune the key parameters: learning rate, discount factor, exploration, and delay.
You can switch between algorithms and strategies at any point during training.
All controls are clearly labeled and easy to reach.
As training runs, these four charts track how rewards and episode lengths change over time.
The Analysis tab shows deeper statistics — state coverage, action counts, and model sync status.
This chart compares the value the agent assigns to each action against how often it actually picks them.
The heatmap shows which action the agent prefers in each region of the state space.
The max Q-value view reveals where the agent is most confident in its decisions.
The min Q-value view highlights areas where the agent is still uncertain.
The slice chart lets you examine how values shift along a single dimension of the state.
And the action wheel maps each action to a distinct color, making patterns easier to spot.
The pointer guide can also speed up when you just need a quick overview.
When you're ready to train on your own, the guide steps aside and leaves you with a clean interface.
